item.title: Friday 1 PM Update, Nov 27
item.description:
The Black Friday one o'clock update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 27, 2026: Branchburg, New Jersey weather for the next 24 hours; US forces disable another blockade runner off Iran, and Los Angeles schools find a way to switch off Google's AI answers; Canada's Supreme Court upholds Quebec's religious symbols law, and New Zealand's election leaves a newcomer party as kingmaker; an in-depth markets look at Wall Street's half-day close and a winning week, record Thanksgiving online spending and Anthropic back above its IPO price; Nvidia's newest servers turn up in Shanghai and the New York Times tells photographers to skip the new Photoshop; a viral claim that Claude sabotages research, checked against the record, and an OpenAI billing fix; a cyberattack halts a Wyoming uranium plant and Chinese state hackers adopt an AI attack tool; your X feed; Somerset County storm cleanup, a library account warning and weekend events; and a Paralympian's Dancing With the Stars win for a young Boston Children's patient. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Friday 10 AM Update, Nov 27

Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.
